review_description: These guys know their stuff.  The quote was within reason and they were very upfront and honest.  The communication was excellent as was the install (within a week) and the customer service.  I had other slightly cheaper quotes but these guys at AHElectrical were committed and focussed on the customer.  I have now had them install my solar panels (10kw) and my batteries and cannot fault them.  Excellent work and follow up.
Local dealer as we live in Moonta Bay
